entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I... I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Chen. The order number is VF880219.

Thank you, Alex. I have your order pulled up. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 15 days ago. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?
Oh, no, it's not a fault. I was so excited for it. It's just... I haven't even had a chance to open it. Things just got complicated, and honestly, I really need the money back right now.

I understand. I'm pulling up the policy for this specific item now. One moment... Okay, so for the VeloBand Pulse, because it's a device that gets linked to a user account and for hygiene reasons, we have a strict 10-day return window. Since it's been 15 days, I'm afraid it's outside that period.
Ten days? Oh, no. I had no idea. I... I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I just assumed it was the usual policy. There was no way I could have called sooner.
I do apologize for the difficult news. Is there a particular reason you weren't able to contact us within the first 10 days?

My husband... he had a sudden medical emergency right after the package arrived. He was rushed to the hospital and needed immediate surgery. I've been there with him ever since. This is the first moment I've had to even think about anything else. I feel terrible even calling about this, but things are tight.
Oh my, I am so incredibly sorry to hear that. Please, don't feel terrible. That sounds like a very difficult and stressful situation for your family. Thank you for sharing that with me.
It has been. I just... I wouldn't have even bought it if I knew this was coming.

Of course. And please, don't worry about the policy. VeloFit absolutely makes exceptions for significant life events like a medical emergency. Given the situation with your husband's surgery and hospital stay, I can definitely authorize a one-time exception for you.
You can? Really?

Yes, absolutely. This is exactly what our exception policy is for. It's not like a military deployment where you might have advance notice; a health emergency is completely unforeseen. I am going to process this as a full refund back to your original method of payment. I'll email you a prepaid return label right now. Just pack the item back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off.
Oh, Diana, thank you so much. That is such a huge relief. I can't tell you how much I appreciate your understanding. You've been wonderful.
You are very welcome, Alex. I'm just happy I could help ease one small thing for you during a tough time. I've just sent that email. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, and I hope you have a good day.
You too, Alex. And I wish your husband a swift and full recovery. Take care.
